scope: Current v0.5.0 development candidate on the tested Linux FreeCAD 1.1.4 GUI host.
windows_status: unknown: this sequence was not tested on Windows
native_sequence: Create baseline target object outside a transaction.
Create a disposable object in one committed transaction.
Delete that disposable object in one committed transaction.
Invoke native Std_Undo to restore deletion.
Invoke native Std_Undo to reverse creation.
Commit a new Label change on the baseline target, discarding the previous Redo branch.
Invoke native Std_Undo on the Label change.
Invoke native Std_Redo; tested host crashes.

mechanism_inference: A stale non-null ViewProvider pointer retained in the native deferred-child list after Undo/removal and Redo-branch discard. This is inferred from the isolated repro and local disassembly, not a proven memory-debugger diagnosis.
disassembly_observations: handleChildren3D checks ViewProvider for null before the failing first virtual call at +0x3a.
Gui::Document::redo traverses and clears its deferred ViewProvider-pointer list after applying App redo.
Gui::Document::undo does not traverse or clear that deferred list.
user_impact: Native process crash may lose unsaved state in the running FreeCAD process.
safe_api_workaround: None established. Main-event-loop settling and ordinary Part::Feature do not avoid the crash.
